concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑002 (compute‑time ≤ 6 h) is not referenced anywhere in the plan. The spec requires this metric to be measured, but the implementation phases never mention tracking or validating total runtime.
The plan lists FR‑014 as addressed in Phase 2, yet FR‑014 does not exist in the feature specification. This is an over‑reach; the plan should only reference FRs defined in the spec.
